newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed on spotty demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed on spotty demand.

text.p: Nearby millfeed values were mixed on Thursday with some areas reporting very strong demand from feed mixers while others said end-users had filled immediate needs and backed out of the market.
"Millfeed is extremely tight in St. Louis," one dealer said, noting bids were up $5 per ton and offers were up $8. "The supplies really are dwindling and demand has picked up."
Most of the interest was from feed mixers in Missouri and Texas, he said. A Texas dealer confirmed there was active trade and strong demand, noting buyers were interested primarily in spot shipment.

"People in the country are buying feed so the mixers are busy," the Texas dealer said but added there was little interest in deferred positions. "There's nothing going on past December. The only thing anyone is interested in is spot."
But in the East, abundant supplies and light demand kept prices mostly steady to weaker, dealers said. Prices fell in the Carolinas and Buffalo.
